messages:
Maya: heads-up: final readiness sync for EdgeCloud x Stratus marketplace listing. small list of must-haves before embargo. who can take each?
Jon (Product): i'll own routing + billing flag. will update the SKU sheet by 3pm PT.
Priya: marketing will own blog + press outreach. blog draft (600-900w) and hero microcopy by Thu noon. Need partner quote signed by Fri COB.
Nina (Design): i can deliver hero comps and badge spec (120x40 PNG + SVG). ETA 5pm.
Keisha (SI): SI cert status: we've submitted auth tests; one flaky endpoint being retested. target green by Fri EOD.
Sam (Finance): partner-managed billing needs partner tax id + billing contact. partner must supply by tomorrow 11am PT to enable that flow.
LegalBot: embargo proposal: 2026-04-18 08:00 PT. Partners must ACK addendum before embargo or we do staged release. Quotes need partner comms signoff.
Maya: quick runbook paste - owners please ack and update the sheet:
```
RUNBOOK: Marketplace Launch Final
- SKU metadata + redirects: owner=Jon, due=Today 3pm PT, sheet=Marketplace_SKUs_v4
- Hero comps + badge: owner=Nina, due=5pm PT, drive/marketplace/edge-stratus
- Blog draft + press list: owner=Priya, blog due=Thu 12pm, press list due=Today EOD
- SI cert matrix: owner=Keisha, ETA=Fri EOD
- Billing mode decision: owner=Sam, partner input due=Tomorrow 11am PT
- Embargo signoff: owner=LegalBot, partners ACK by Fri COB
- Staging push: owner=PlatformOps, scheduled=2026-04-17 22:00 PT
- Dry run: 30min preflight call 2026-04-18 09:00 PT (ops+infra+partner)
```
Jon (Product): noted. i'll add redirect 301s for promo links and set feature flag partner_trial=false for enterprise listings.
Priya: question: hero CTA - Start free trial vs Contact SI? recommend trial for PLG.
Maya: agree default = Start free trial, Contact SI as secondary. we'll A/B test on 20% traffic.
Nina (Design): uploaded assets -> https://drive.redwood/marketplace/edge-stratus (files: hero_A.png, hero_B.png, badge_color.png, badge_mono.svg)
Keisha (SI): will be on the dry run with Stratus test lead.
Sam (Finance): looping finance on DM for billing fields.
LegalBot: added redline to MSA addendum in drive; partners must ACK.
DeployBot: reminder: schema validation runs at 21:30 PT; missing canonical tags will fail the push.
Maya: please react with :white_check_mark: when your row in the sheet is updated. we'll close thread after dry run.
Jon (Product): :white_check_mark:
